name: skill-bazaar
description: A curated marketplace of cross-tool AI agent skills and plugins.

plugins.name: mikrotik-routeros
plugins.description: Design, configure, audit, and troubleshoot MikroTik RouterOS networks — CAPsMAN/wifi, VLANs, firewall and multi-layer NAT, bridging with hardware offload, routing, DHCP, QoS, VPNs, and .rsc scripting on RouterOS 7.20+.

plugins.name: agent-delegation
plugins.description: Protocol for handing work to a subagent that cannot ask the human mid-run: delegate by default with two main-session carve-outs (secret values, human confirmations), a decision-completeness gate, a pause clause so a subagent that hits an open decision keeps its context and is resumed with the answer, a toolset check before evidence is named, and artifact verification instead of exit codes.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts ~75% of tokens while keeping full technical accuracy by speaking like a caveman.

plugins.name: limit-guard
plugins.description: Pause a Claude Code session before it burns through the 5-hour or 7-day usage window, wait for the reset without spending tokens, and resume automatically.

plugins.name: bobby-statusline
plugins.description: One status line row for caveman, ste, and limit-guard: badges, vim mode, context, usage windows or cost, prompt cache with TTL and expiry, model, agent, and PR. One python3 process, no chaining.

plugins.name: ste
plugins.description: Simple Technical English (ASD-STE100) for Claude Code, bridged to caveman: caveman's compressed style stays the default, and STE takes over on exactly the turns caveman itself says to drop compression. Toggle with /ste:ste on|off|status; the setting persists across sessions.

plugins.name: herd-forge
plugins.description: Forge and drive a herd in Herdr: one agent per pane, Claude panes started with permissions bypassed, other CLI agents on the same goal, a model and effort choice per role, turnover over compaction run by a steward, and a liaison that fronts the operator and writes the herd report.

plugins.name: herd-delegation
plugins.description: Delegate one unit of work to an agent in its own Herdr tab and drive that pane as a real terminal: when a pane beats a background subagent, the tab-per-agent rule, the brief with an ask-in-the-pane clause instead of a stop clause, a report file asked for up front, the review pane, the context threshold on reuse, and what a pane changes for the two things that stay with the parent (secret values, human consent). Builds on agent-delegation and on the reference that herdr --skill prints.

plugins.name: herd-rigor
plugins.description: Optional evidence and review discipline for work where a wrong answer costs more than a slow one: measured-or-argued labels, three numbers and a control on every absence claim, predictions recorded before the run, the freeze and review gate with four verdicts, checker independence, and a rule budget that stops the method from eating the work.

plugins.name: static-analysis-controls
plugins.description: Controls for counting, searching and claiming absence across a corpus of files or binaries: denominators that symlinks inflate, a grep that is a shell function, positive and discrimination controls, indirect references that defeat a direct search, the backward window for a register load, and addresses that shift between versions.

plugins.name: ontrak-adu218
plugins.description: Drive an Ontrak ADU218 relay and opto-input box safely through the adu CLI: a channel is resolved from the operator's wiring map or refused, the guard narrows the bench to the channels one session needs, every write is read back, and the exit codes name the next step.

plugins.name: korad-ka3305p
plugins.description: Drive a Korad KA3305P bench power supply safely through the korad CLI from the iot-lab repository: guard first, current limit before voltage, read-back on every write, unattended limits, and exit codes that name the next step.

plugins.name: decision-board
plugins.description: Build and run a decision board, a private claude.ai artifact with a database, where an agent posts questions, actions and reference pages and the operator answers from a phone or a browser. One unchanged page, set up by a config document in the database.
